recent_posts.title: React Native Over-the-Air Updates in 2026: Skip the App Store Wait with Codemagic CodePush
recent_posts.summary: React Native apps have a two-layer architecture where the JavaScript bundle can be updated independently of the native binary. Over-the-air (OTA) updates exploit this to push JS changes, bug fixes, and asset updates directly to users without App Store or Google Play review. Codemagic CodePush is a hosted OTA service supporting React Native 0.76+ including the New Architecture, offering staged rollouts, analytics dashboards, automatic rollback, CI/CD integration, and SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 compliance. Pricing starts at $1 per 2,500 installs pay-as-you-go or $99/month per 100K MAU for larger teams. Best practices covered include staged rollouts starting at 5–10%, separate staging/production channels, pre-tested rollback plans, and post-deploy monitoring.

recent_posts.title: CI/CD Build Speed Benchmark: Codemagic vs GitHub Actions vs Bitrise
recent_posts.summary: A benchmark comparing iOS build speeds across Codemagic, GitHub Actions, and Bitrise using the same production-level Flutter app (Medito). GitHub Actions (M1, 3-core) took 16 min 10 sec as the baseline. Bitrise M2 Pro Large and Codemagic M2 both completed in 7 min 28 sec (~2.2x faster), while Codemagic M4 finished in 6 min 43 sec (~2.4x faster). Cost analysis shows GitHub Actions is cheapest for low build volumes due to its free tier, Bitrise's flat $218/month Pro plan suits teams with consistent high volume, and Codemagic offers competitive pay-as-you-go rates with an unlimited fixed-price plan at $3,990/year for heavy users.
